productChangeOwnedByParent: App.tsx retains latest project in ref and stable editor key; no chart algorithm changes
notes: Each run uses real locator.fill, input capture, exact SVG text via MutationObserver, two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; 10 templates x3 samples.

Concurrent runs retain two Playwright workers; second worker executes original workflow tests (data validation/edit/save/reopen, SVG download, page navigation). Only measurement page gets 4x CPU throttle.
Diagnostic baseline uses document input capture + body MutationObserver for identity investigation; it is not substituted for the acceptance test.

Early tmp test failures were a CJS-transformation diagnostic error (_nodePerf_hooks undefined), not evidence of remount or product latency. Adding package.json type=module restored the repository test environment.

Linux baseline has 30 valid measurements, pooled p95=369.5ms and 3 samples above300ms. The top3 have near-equal input→DOM and later-frame costs, compatible with the confirmed second full render; no Linux CPU trace exists to isolate CPU contention contribution.
